odd_even.verdict_text: The two dips are different sizes — odd transits dip 0.001% but even transits dip 0.010% (87% apart). That is the classic sign of an eclipsing binary whose real period is twice the candidate period.

kill_reason: stage (b): the raw 2P fold contains NO eclipse at either parity (odd +0.001%, even +0.010% vs pipeline depth 0.749%; deepest fold dip = 1.3% of BLS depth, far under the 25% evaporation threshold) - the signal evaporated in the raw fold; the app ratio rule fires 'likely-eclipsing-binary' on the ratio of two noise-level numbers, but with no eclipses present there is nothing to alternate. Classified PIPELINE PHANTOM per the sweep-1 definition (identical pattern to TIC 294671640). Raw app verdict preserved in odd_even.verdict / app_odd_even_verdict_raw.
